categories.main_business_segments: Baiksan Co., Ltd primarily operates in the synthetic leather manufacturing industry, producing polyurethane synthetic leather used in sports shoes, electronic product cases, and automotive interior materials. The company also engages in finance, trade, and garment production and export through its subsidiaries. Its main focus is on synthetic leather production and sales, with significant operations in sports footwear, electronic cases, and automotive interiors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes polyurethane synthetic resin and nonwoven fabric foaming agents to manufacture synthetic leather. It has developed proprietary water-based polyurethane resin technologies and solvent-free polyurethane foaming methods, collaborating with Japanese and other technology partners. Production involves advanced composite spinning and polyurethane processing technologies, enabling high-quality, environmentally friendly synthetic leather products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Baiksan's primary customers are global sports footwear brands such as NIKE, ADIDAS, and REEBOK, which account for over 80% of its sales. The company serves markets for sports shoes, electronic device cases (e.g., smartphones, tablets), and automotive interior materials. Its products are used in diverse applications including footwear, apparel, bags, sports goods, furniture, and automotive components.
categories.geographic_coverage: Baiksan operates manufacturing facilities and subsidiaries in South Korea, Indonesia, China, and Vietnam, strategically located near major customers' factories. The company exports globally, with significant sales in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Asia. Its production footprint in Southeast Asia supports cost efficiency and rapid supply to international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Baiksan operates primarily in the midstream segment of the synthetic leather supply chain, manufacturing synthetic leather materials from raw polyurethane resins and nonwoven fabrics. It supplies these materials to downstream manufacturers of footwear, electronics cases, and automotive interiors. The company also engages in some upstream activities through investment in raw material sourcing and technology development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in environmentally friendly synthetic leather technologies, including solvent-free and water-based polyurethane resins. It focuses on developing specialized products for sports shoes, electronic cases, and automotive interiors. Baiksan invests in product diversification, quality enhancement, and new application development to sustain growth and meet evolving customer demands.
categories.revenue_model: Baiksan generates revenue primarily through the sale and export of synthetic leather products. It also earns income from processing services, trading goods, and investment returns from subsidiaries. The majority of revenue comes from direct product sales to major global brands under long-term supply agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include domestic companies like Duksung and Daewon Hwaseong, and international firms such as Taiwan's SANFANG. Baiksan holds a strong market position with approximately 25% market share of synthetic leather used by major global sports brands. It competes mainly on quality and technological capabilities in mid- to high-end synthetic leather segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Baiksan reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 418 billion, with a slight decline from the previous year but improved operating profit. The company has total assets of about KRW 352 billion and equity of KRW 208 billion, reflecting a mid-sized enterprise with steady growth. It maintains a BBB+ credit rating and has shown consistent investment in R&D and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Baiksan differentiates itself through advanced polyurethane synthetic leather technologies, environmentally friendly production methods, and customized product offerings. Its proximity to major global brand factories and ability to provide rapid, tailored supply enhances customer satisfaction. The company emphasizes high-quality, durable, and versatile synthetic leather products that meet stringent global standards and evolving market needs.
